## Activity

East City Eye Clinic recorded 46 captures during July 2020. Activity was completed through the usual site processes, with all captured examinations submitted for image assessment and grading. The reported activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance for the month.

## Image quality

Of the 46 captures, 2 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 4.3 per cent. The result should be monitored through routine quality review, with attention to the factors affecting image acquisition and the consistency of images submitted for assessment. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

There were 8 referable results during July 2020. The median grading lag was 1 day. This indicates that grading was completed within a short interval for the month, while the referable findings remain subject to the established clinical follow-up arrangements. Overall, the site report records activity, image quality, and grading outcomes for East City Eye Clinic for July 2020.
